result.title: From Restoration to Redrawing: Revitalizing Ancient Chinese Characters by SVG Code Generation and Editing
result.summary: Hanjian manuscripts written on Han Dynasty bamboo and wooden slips are invaluable heritage of ancient Chinese writing but suffer from damaged ink and incomplete strokes. Existing image-to-image restoration methods may alter observed strokes and offer limited control over stroke geometry. Inspired by experts' manual redrawing practices, we address these issues by introducing \textbf{ReDraw}, a two-stage vision-language model(VLM) that reformulates character restoration as Scalable Vector Graphics(SVG) code generation and editing. Stage one targets faithful vectorization of observed strokes geometry or conservative tracing of mildly degraded strokes. Guided by skeleton chain-of-thought reasoning and reinforcement learning with structure-aware rewards, stage two predicts skeletons before contours to redraw severely incomplete strokes by appending paths while keeping existing SVG paths unchanged. To support training, we develop a multi-layer data synthesis pipeline that disentangles ink, material, and degradation to generate 1.2M samples, and derive up to 6,400 adaptation pairs from 320 annotated real glyphs. Experiments demonstrate synthetic restoration performance and adaptability to real Hanjian glyphs. Code and demo will be available upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ReDraw 两阶段 VLM，将汉代简牍残字修复重构为 SVG 代码生成与编辑：先忠实矢量化可观察笔画，再借骨架链式思考与结构感知奖励的强化学习预测骨架、追加路径重绘严重残缺笔画。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先预测骨架再生成轮廓」的中间结构表示、结构感知奖励，以及不改动已有路径的保守编辑，可能为 LVR 中的中间状态监督与视觉证据保留提供可核查线索，但任务本身是字形修复，与多模态推理主线距离较远。
